subject: OrthoSys Dedicated Capacity — pre-hold request & sizing validation
messages:
From: Emily Tran <emily.tran@orthosys.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@orthosys.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Need to pre-hold capacity for pilot -> production ramp

Hi Marcus,

Quick note from OrthoSys — thanks again for the demo last week. Our infra team finished profiling expected inference patterns for our radiology ingest pipeline and the numbers look like a heavy steady-state with predictable weekly peaks. We’re in late-stage procurement and need to ask Redwood to temporarily "pre-hold" capacity while contract language and SOC-2 review finish (target window: Jan–Mar 2027).

High-level ask: can you put a soft hold on ~6 GPUs of A100-80GB (or equivalent H100 capacity) in us-west for a 90-day window with option to convert to a Dedicated commitment upon signature? We’ll share the traffic profile (attached). Goals: eliminate a last-minute capacity risk and ensure predictable latency for our initial rollout.

Attachments: orthosys_traffic_profile_q4.csv

What info do you need from us to make this happen? Also, is there a standard pre-hold governance/charge you apply for late-stage deals?

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Tran
Head of Platform Engineering, OrthoSys

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@orthosys.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@orthosys.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Need to pre-hold capacity for pilot -> production ramp

Emily — appreciate the heads-up and for sharing the profile. 

We can do a temporary capacity pre-hold; want to make sure internal teams validate availability and agree on the financial guardrails. Internal next steps from our side: 1) confirm hardware match (A100-80GB vs H100 equivalent) and available pool in us-west, 2) propose a minimal pre-hold fee or invoice credit structure, and 3) lock in conversion terms (how hold converts to dedicated committed capacity).

I've looped in Aisha (AE lead) to coordinate commercial details and Karthik and Laura on capacity/sizing. For the engineering side, a few quick clarifying Qs that will speed the sizing check:
- Is the 6 GPUs estimate steady or a burst delta above a shared pool?
- Expected average sequence length / tokens per request?
- Any latency SLOs (p50/p95) for the production rollout?

Emily — if you can answer those 3 bullets we’ll run a quick availability and cost suggestion and get back within 48 hours.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -08:00
Subject: FW: OrthoSys pre-hold request — need availability + proposed terms

Team — forwarding Emily's request. TL;DR: OrthoSys asked for a 90-day soft hold of ~6 GPUs in us-west, conversion option to committed Dedicated if signed. We should return: available node types, suggested hold pricing (credit vs upfront), and any reservations on fulfilling H100 equivalents.

Karthik/Laura: can you do an inventory check and suggested sizing (A100-80 vs H100-equivalent) and expected lead time if we convert to Dedicated? Also flag any constraints (e.g., 4-week provisioning minimum).
Vivek: heads-up on potential credit/discount ask — they often push for a small refundable deposit instead of fees. What’s the margin floor for us?

Thanks — aim to respond to Emily in 48 hours.

-Aisha
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: OrthoSys pre-hold request — availability check and sizing recommendation

Folks — did an availability sweep for us-west region:
- Inventory snapshot (as of 2026-11-27): 18x A100-80GB free in reserved pool, 10x H100-equivalent slots (not yet fully warmed).
- For a 90-day soft hold: recommend reserving 6x A100-80GB nodes (or 4x H100-equivalents) to match their perf envelope. H100-equivalents give ~1.6x throughput for our serving stack but require warmup (KV cache priming) — expect +48–72h tuning after conversion.
- Lead time to convert to Dedicated (provisioning & SLA config): 10–14 business days if nodes are available; if we allocate existing reserved pool it can be immediate but with a short cooldown to apply isolation and billing changes.

Cost/guardrails suggestion:
- Soft-hold fee: charge a refundable 15% of 90-day committed cost upfront as a hold deposit (applies to first invoice if converted). This protects capacity while not fully locking cost for OrthoSys.
- If customer requires zero upfront, offer a 7-day unconfirmed hold (no charges) but we can only hold 2 GPUs with that softness.

Attachments: capacity_request_form_v2.pdf (internal hold form with SKU mapping and conversion checkbox)

If leadership wants to waive to win the deal we can offer a partial credit; Vivek — please advise margin impact if we move to 10% refundable vs 15%.

-Laura
Sr. Infra Product Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Tran <emily.tran@orthosys.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procure@orthosys.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: OrthoSys Dedicated Capacity — pre-hold request & sizing validation

Emily — thanks for the quick follow-up and for the traffic details. Summary of what we can do and proposed next steps: 

1) Availability & sizing
- We can place a soft hold on 6x A100-80GB nodes in us-west for the requested 90-day window (2027-01-10 through 2027-04-10). As Laura noted, 4x H100-equivalents would likely meet throughput with lower headcount but require ~48–72h runtime tuning on conversion.

2) Commercial guardrail options (choose one):
A) Standard refundable deposit: 15% of the 90-day estimated Dedicated cost charged up front; deposit applies to first invoice if converted.
B) Light soft-hold: no charge, hold up to 2 GPUs only (we can extend total time by mutual agreement).

3) Conversion path
- If you sign the Dedicated order, converting the hold is a paperwork-triggered operation; provisioning to a fully isolated Dedicated instance typically completes within 10–14 business days (faster if we map to already-reserved nodes).

4) Next steps for OrthoSys
- Confirm intended hold size (6 A100 or 4 H100-equiv) and preferred guardrail (A or B).
- Sign the attached capacity request form (we’ll send a DocuSign to streamline).
- Optional: share average tokens per request and p95 latency SLO for the pilot so we can pre-configure batching and cache policies.

I’ll queue the hold once we have confirmation from Emily/Procurement. If you want leadership to consider a one-time credit (10% vs default 15%) to accelerate signature, cc Vivek and I’ll escalate.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: capacity_request_form_v2.pdf
